characteristic.description: Adults with a measured systolic blood pressure between 130 and 180 mmHg inclusive, together with at least one of: clinical or subclinical cardiovascular disease, chronic kidney disease with eGFR 20-59 mL/min/1.73 m2, a 10-year Framingham risk score of 15 percent or greater, or age 75 years or older.

valueCodeableConcept.text: Hypertension with systolic blood pressure 130-180 mmHg and at least one additional cardiovascular risk factor

characteristic.description: Aged 50 years or older at the time of eligibility assessment. No upper age limit is applied.
Any antihypertensive regimen titrated at monthly intervals to achieve and maintain a systolic blood pressure below 120 mmHg. The specific agents used are not constrained by this question.

valueCodeableConcept.text: Intensive blood-pressure control: antihypertensive therapy titrated to a systolic target below 120 mmHg

characteristic.description: Any antihypertensive regimen titrated to achieve and maintain a systolic blood pressure below 140 mmHg, reflecting the guideline-recommended target in force at the time the question was formulated.

valueCodeableConcept.text: Standard blood-pressure control: antihypertensive therapy titrated to a systolic target below 140 mmHg

characteristic.description: Time to first occurrence of any component of the composite, adjudicated by a committee unaware of treatment assignment. Individual components are reported as separate outcome measures in the evidence report.

valueCodeableConcept.text: Major adverse cardiovascular events: composite of myocardial infarction, other acute coronary syndrome, stroke, acute decompensated heart failure, or death from cardiovascular causes
